name: Kai (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kai city emblem in green: an interlaced loop of green ribbons in two shades.
history: Municipal flag of Kai, a city in Yamanashi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 2005.

features.role: Kai city emblem — an interlaced loop of green ribbons in two shades
